lineas.texto: Pause on the sky. That balloon has an eye, and it is looking straight at you.
lineas.accion: Emotion: flat, expressionless. She starts deadpan, eyes fixed on the lens; on 'looking straight at you' only her eyes slide slowly up to the sky and back; she ends eyes back on the lens, zero expression. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: deadpan, eyes fixed on the lens
direccion.gesto: on 'looking straight at you' only her eyes slide slowly up to the sky and back
direccion.sale: eyes back on the lens, zero expression (cut to his quote)

lineas.texto: My drawings inspire, and are not to be defined.
lineas.tts: My drawings inspire... and are not to be defined.

lineas.texto: So, don't ask what it means. He won't tell you. He's been dead since 1916.
lineas.accion: Emotion: ironic disinterest. She starts the same flat face she left with; one slow blink on 'he won't tell you'; the smallest shrug of the head on 'dead since 1916'; she ends motionless. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: the same flat face she left with
direccion.gesto: one slow blink on 'he won't tell you'; the smallest shrug of the head on 'dead since 1916'

lineas.texto: Odilon Redon. Bordeaux, 1840. Born Bertrand: he took the name Odilon from his mother, Odile.
lineas.tts: Odilon Redon. Bordeaux, 1840. Born Bertrand... he took the name Odilon from his mother, Odile.

lineas.texto: For decades he drew only in black. Charcoal, lithographs. He called them his noirs.
lineas.accion: Emotion: dry. She starts flat, the voice even; her eyebrows barely move; a tiny unimpressed nod on 'his noirs'; she ends still. No hands, no body.

direccion.gesto: her eyebrows barely move; a tiny unimpressed nod on 'his noirs'

lineas.texto: In 1884 a famous novel gave its decadent hero a collection of Redon drawings. Suddenly, Paris wanted one.
lineas.tts: In 1884 a famous novel gave its decadent hero a collection of Redon drawings. [dry] Suddenly... Paris wanted one.

lineas.texto: Then, after 1900, the black stopped. Pastels, oil, colour everywhere. Same man.
lineas.accion: Emotion: held-back surprise. She starts flat; her eyes widen for a split second on 'colour everywhere' and go flat again on 'same man'; she ends flat again, as if nothing happened. No hands, no body.

direccion.gesto: her eyes widen for a split second on 'colour everywhere' and go flat again on 'same man'
direccion.sale: flat again, as if nothing happened (cut to the flowers)

lineas.texto: In 1913, New York's Armory Show gave him more space than any other artist.
lineas.tts: In 1913, New York's Armory Show gave him more space... than any other artist.

lineas.texto: He wanted the logic of the visible at the service of the invisible. A very normal goal.
lineas.accion: Emotion: irony. She starts a perfect poker face while she quotes him; one eyebrow lifts on 'a very normal goal'; she ends the eyebrow stays up. No hands, no body.

direccion.entra: a perfect poker face while she quotes him
direccion.gesto: one eyebrow lifts on 'a very normal goal'
direccion.sale: the eyebrow stays up (jump cut to the last line)

lineas.texto: So. The balloon with the eye? It is still looking at you. Don't look up.
lineas.accion: Emotion: dry, slightly eerie. She starts landing big from the punch-in, deadpan; her eyes flick up and back on 'still looking at you'; on 'don't look up' she holds perfectly still, then one slow blink; she ends still, looking at us: the button appears. No hands, no body.
